gbm_population_evidence.quote: 68Ga/177Lu-PSMA Theranostics in Recurrent Grade 3 and Grade 4 Glioma
A previous diagnosis of histologically confirmed WHO grade 3 or grade 4 glioma

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is named only via the historical term 'grade 4 glioma' (no IDH requirement) alongside grade 3 glioma; could alternatively be read as high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: introduce a novel, well-tolerated radionuclide treatment that possibly can increase the overall survival and quality of life

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Radiologically (MRI) confirmed tumor relapse/progression ≥ 12 weeks since completed radiotherapy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Calculation of absorbed doses to the tumor and kidneys, parotid glands, sublingual glands, submandibular glands, lacrimal glands, liver, spleen and red marrow for each therapy cycle
SPECT/CT will be performed after each cycle of treatment for dosimetry calculations

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Measure changes in uptake (SUV) of 68Ga-PSMA during the treatment period and correlate to overall survival in order to evaluate the role of post-therapeutic 68Ga-PSMA PET in monitoring disease.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] 68Ga/177Lu-PSMA theranostics in recurrent grade 3 and grade 4 glioma

agents.drug_class_hint: lutetium-177 labelled PSMA-targeting radioligand (PSMA imaging & therapy ligand; possibly zadavotide guraxetan), isotope 177Lu
arms: 68Ga/177Lu-PSMA theranostics in recurrent grade 3 and grade 4 glioma

role_evidence.quote: Patients demonstrating a high tumor uptake of 68Ga-PSMA on the diagnostic PET/MRI examination in the screening part of the study are eligible

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled PSMA PET imaging tracer, isotope 68Ga
arms: 68Ga/177Lu-PSMA theranostics in recurrent grade 3 and grade 4 glioma

biomarkers.biomarker_other: PSMA expression (high tumour uptake on 68Ga-PSMA PET)

source_quote.quote: High tumor uptake on diagnostic imaging with 68Ga -PSMA.

flag.reason: Target-expression entry requirement is assessed by imaging only; manual excludes imaging-only markers unless described as a biomarker endpoint (PSMA uptake is correlated with outcomes), so inclusion as a molecular biomarker is debatable.

coder_notes: Phase registered as NA (fails S3 by [CODE]); coded in full anyway. 68Ga-PSMA is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it for screening in this theranostic design, so listed as a diagnostic_agent row per W1. Moiety for 177Lu-PSMA I&T kept as the record's ligand name without isotope since no INN is stated. tumour_pk_planned coded yes because SPECT/CT dosimetry quantifies absorbed dose (radioligand uptake) in tumour; this is imaging-based rather than tissue/CSF sampling, adjudicator may prefer no. target_engagement coded no: serial 68Ga-PSMA uptake is described as disease monitoring rather than target modulation.
